title: Run independent release-journey QA
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Verify the release from the operator and member entry points.

**Expected behaviour** · Use two homes and the built launcher. Check server-first startup, wrong server, revocation, delayed responses, reconnect, different-port restart and member-specific settings.

**Scope boundary** · Independent QA against the v0.2 client and released v0.1 backend.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-039

**Depends on** · WI-027, WI-028, WI-033, WI-036, WI-037, WI-039

**Verify** · Attach candidate identity, commands, observed results and reproduction steps for every failed scenario.

**Effort basis** · Multi-step verification against explicit outcomes.
evidence: GLM 5.3 Flash report in versions/0.2 FoundationOS/agents/qa/WI-040/report.md: 18 scenarios plus a retest, combined 22 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 SKIP, Sev-1 count 0. Found and reproduced one Sev-1 (Start.cmd rejected the positional URL because unescaped parentheses broke cmd block parsing) and one Sev-2 (two PI documents without revision headers); both fixed and retested PASS. Revocation, offline, wrong-version, non-loopback, preferences matrix, stale-response code review and different-port restart all passed. Screenshots: qa/sprint-5/WI-040/.
